summary: Constructs laser image frames from SOP, CHOP, or POP sources and sends them to Pangolin Beyond show-control software.
key_concepts: Pangolin CHOP is a Windows-only interface from TouchDesigner to Pangolin Beyond laser show-control software.
It sends laser image frames from SOP, CHOP, or POP sources into a selected Beyond zone.
Pangolin Beyond must be open before active input displays the laser image in the selected zone.
CHOP input requires x and y point channels, with optional z, r, g, b, id, and zone channels.
SOP and POP sources use point positions and color/zone attributes for laser image grouping and routing.
Because this is live laser output, generated plans should include explicit laser safety and licensing checks.

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: CHOP source with named point/color channels

key_params.name: ratemode
key_params.note: Percent of projector sample rate or explicit sample rate

key_params.name: repeat
key_params.note: Repeat source data to fit output rate

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
Pangolin Beyond must be open; with the CHOP active and connected, the laser image appears immediately in the selected Beyond zone.
Non-Commercial TouchDesigner only works with the demo version of Beyond; licensed Beyond requires Commercial, Educational, or Pro TouchDesigner.
CHOP input requires x and y channels; optional z, r, g, b, id, and zone channels control shape grouping, color, and zone overrides.
POP input requires point position attribute P; point Color defaults to white if absent, and primitive Zone can route primitives.
This is live laser/show-control output, so generated plans should require explicit laser-safety review.
